name: Phu Nhai basilica
nameVi: Vương cung thánh đường Phú Nhai
summary: Look at the gray church at Xuân Phương, more than 1 km from the Xuân Trường town. It is called one of the widest churches in the country. The fee, a height, and a mass hour are Check on arrival. It is not Nhà thờ Lớn in the center, and it is not Phát Diệm.

body: Vương cung thánh đường Phú Nhai is at xã Xuân Phương, huyện Xuân Trường, more than 1 km from thị trấn Xuân Trường. It is called one of the widest churches in the country. You look at the facade from the front court. A height, a fee, and a mass hour are Check on arrival.

Do not merge it with Nhà thờ Lớn, the center parish at số 16 phố Hai Bà Trưng, or with Tòa giám mục Bùi Chu at xã Xuân Ngọc. Bùi Chu dates from 1885 and is 78 m long, 22 m wide, and 15 m high. Check a mass hour for Bùi Chu on arrival. Phát Diệm’s stone church is in Kim Sơn, on the Ninh Bình side.

figures.caption: The long side of the church, with the arched windows
figures.alt: The side of Phu Nhai basilica, gray stone and tall arched windows, with potted trees

gettingThere: The church is more than 1 km from thị trấn Xuân Trường. Quốc lộ 21 runs from the city through Cổ Lễ and Xuân Trường. Check the minutes on arrival.

legs.heading: From Nam Dinh
legs.body: Toward Xuân Trường, more than 1 km from the town once you are there. Check the minutes from the center on arrival.
